rationale: Du et al. 2023 is the corpus's positive evidence for multi-agent debate; it grounds one side of the required reconciliation (D11), informs the baseline comparison (D4), and defines the replication arm of the evaluation plan (D14).
text: Read papers/text/du-et-al-2023-multiagent-debate.txt and extract, each anchored to the exact `===== PDF PAGE N =====` marker(s): the improvements in factuality and reasoning the paper claims for multiagent debate, the experimental setup (number of agents, number of debate rounds, tasks used, and how consensus or a final answer is reached), and any limitations the authors state.
